run_bop24_gpu_eval: run the BOP24 pose evaluation script on LMO and TLESS datasets using GPU rendering
test_false_positive_injection: test the BOP24 evaluator by injecting dummy false positive pose estimates into results
verify_bop24_scores: verify BOP24 mAP scores against expected values for LMO and TLESS test datasets
load_bop_results: load BOP pose estimation results from a CSV file using inout.load_bop_results with bop19 version
save_bop_results: save modified BOP pose estimation results to a CSV file using inout.save_bop_results with bop19 version
